stemMd: A 40 N force acts in the same direction as a displacement of 3 m. How much work does it do?
explanationMd: Work by a constant force is Fd cos θ. Here the force and displacement are parallel, so θ = 0 and cos θ = 1. Thus W = 40 × 3 = 120 J. The joule equals a newton metre.

distractorRationale.e: This divides force by distance instead of multiplying.
distractorRationale.a: Force and distance cannot be added to obtain work.
distractorRationale.b: Work would be zero for a perpendicular force, not a parallel one.
